en.description:
CalcMaster is the only calculator you need on your phone. One polished app, ten unit categories, five calculator modes, seven finance tools, eight engineering utilities, and a notes pad — all designed for travelers, students, freelancers, and anyone who does the math.

—— What you can do ——

CONVERT (10 categories)
Distance · Volume · Weight · Temperature · Speed · Area · Data Size · Fuel Economy · Pressure · Energy. Tap any category, type a value, and instantly see every other unit. Big accent-tinted result + a complete cross-reference list.

CALCULATE (5 modes)
Standard four-function · Scientific (sin / cos / tan / log / ln / √ / x^y / n!) · Percentage (X% of Y, % change, increase/decrease) · Base converter (binary / octal / decimal / hex) · Fraction (add, subtract, multiply, divide, simplify, mixed numbers).

FINANCE (7 tools)
Income tax with real 2025–2026 brackets for US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, India, and Japan — including filing-status differences and standard deductions · Sales tax / VAT · Tip & split · Discount · Compound interest with optional monthly contributions · EMI / loan amortization · Live currency rates from the European Central Bank with offline fallback · Unit-price comparison.

TOOLS (8 utilities)
GPS coordinates (decimal ↔ DMS) with one-tap "Use my location" · Ohm's Law solver from any two of V, I, R, P · BMI with healthy-range bands · Date difference · World time zones · ADC / DAC voltage ↔ digital code · Age calculator · Aspect ratio.

NOTES
Save calculations, formulas, and reminders. Search, edit, delete. Stays on your device — no account, no sync.

—— Why CalcMaster ——

• Region-aware. Tap the flag in the header to switch between US, UK, EU, CA, AU, IN, JP. Currency, sales-tax defaults, and progressive tax brackets all update live.

• Beautiful, dark, and fast. Hand-authored line-art icons, neon accents per category, and instant results — no spinners, no waiting.

• Privacy first. Everything runs on-device. We don't ask you to log in, and we don't sell your data. The currency module fetches public European Central Bank rates; that's the only network call.

• Offline ready. Convert, calculate, and budget without a signal. Currency rates cache locally and refresh when you reconnect.

• Consistent and precise. The same calculations and the same answers every time, on every device you sign in from.

—— CalcMaster Pro ——

Optional subscription removes the small banner ad, refreshes currency rates instantly instead of every 24 hours, unlocks advanced finance insights, and supports indie development. Three tiers:
• Monthly $2.99
• Annual $19.99 (save 44%)
• Lifetime $49.99 — pay once, own it forever

Cancel any time from your device's subscription settings.

—— Built for ——

• Travelers calculating tips and currency conversions abroad
• Freelancers estimating taxes after every invoice
• Students checking unit conversions and physics formulas
• Engineers solving voltage drops and ADC resolution
• Cooks scaling recipes between metric and imperial
• Anyone tired of juggling six different apps to do the math

Download CalcMaster and replace your stock calculator. We think you'll like it.

en.release_notes:
Hello, world! This is the first release of CalcMaster.

Highlights of this build:
• 10 unit converters, 5 calculator modes, 7 finance tools, 8 utilities, and a notes pad
• New Calendar tool: month view with ISO week, day-of-year, and quarter
• Region-aware tax + currency for US, UK, EU, CA, AU, IN, JP
• Live European Central Bank exchange rates with offline fallback
• Beautiful dark theme with hand-authored line-art icons
• Optional CalcMaster Pro for ad-free + advanced features

We'd love to hear from you. Tap Settings → Send feedback to reach the team.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
CalcMaster is the only calculator you need on your phone. One polished app, ten unit categories, five calculator modes, seven finance tools, eight engineering utilities, and a notes pad — all designed for travelers, students, freelancers, and anyone who does the math.

Intended audience:
World calculator & converter

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features
- device location services (on-device)
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
